question: Component identity
default: Immutable capability/component ID with exact source and release owner.
alternative_trigger: A repository rename preserves identity and lineage.
acceptance: Resolve source, blob/commit, component profile and consumed artifact.

question: Library versus service
default: Typed local library when lifecycle, deployment and trust allow.
alternative_trigger: Use a service for a real independent lifecycle, trust/failure boundary or remote consumer.
acceptance: Cold consumer and boundary contract test; measure call/deploy overhead.

question: New implementation
default: Reuse or improve the existing external/shared capability.
alternative_trigger: Build new only for a named unsupported requirement or measured outcome advantage.
acceptance: Baseline/current-owner improvement/external alternative comparison.

question: Abstraction depth
default: Expose actual domain semantics with a small contract.
alternative_trigger: Add abstraction only for a demonstrated variation or credible committed consumer.
acceptance: Two meaningful implementations or a precise seam; measure adapter burden.

question: Interop protocol
default: Preserve an already qualified public contract; use typed local calls internally.
alternative_trigger: Qualify C ABI, generated remote RPC or HTTP/schema boundary for actual consumers.
acceptance: Ownership/layout, compatibility, version and error/cancellation tests.

question: Persistence
default: One explicit authoritative writer and minimal durable state required by semantics.
alternative_trigger: Select another data system for measured consistency, concurrency, durability or access requirements.
acceptance: Crash/restart/migration/restore and multi-writer tests where applicable.

question: Schema evolution
default: Version contracts; keep backward compatibility within the accepted envelope.
alternative_trigger: Breaking changes require coordinated consumer migration or a new major surface.
acceptance: Old/new producer-consumer fixtures and migration rollback.

question: Errors
default: Typed failure with category, origin, safe context and retryability.
alternative_trigger: Extend for domain detail without converting errors into success-shaped defaults.
acceptance: Invalid input, permission denial, missing dependency and partial failure canaries.

question: Retries
default: No blind retry of non-idempotent effects.
alternative_trigger: Retry transient, idempotent/deduplicated effects within a deadline and attempt budget.
acceptance: Duplicate delivery, ambiguous completion, timeout and exhausted-budget tests.

question: Cancellation and deadlines
default: Propagate deadline/cancellation through the complete operation tree.
alternative_trigger: Detach only an explicitly durable owned operation with a receipt and lifecycle.
acceptance: Cancellation releases claims/resources and leaves known state.

question: Parallelism
default: Bound tasks by actual CPU/GPU/memory/IO/provider budgets.
alternative_trigger: Increase concurrency when useful throughput improves without violating tail-latency or fairness limits.
acceptance: Saturation, cancellation, starvation and realtime-coexistence tests.

question: Queues/backpressure
default: Use the smallest bounded queue with explicit overload behavior.
alternative_trigger: Durable/shared queue only for required restart, delivery or cross-process semantics.
acceptance: Overflow, order, duplicate, poison-input and consumer crash tests.

question: Workflow triggers
default: Simple trigger plus input readiness, durable dedupe/journal and constrained effect.
alternative_trigger: Use an existing durable workflow engine for required long-lived coordination/replay/compensation.
acceptance: Lost/repeated trigger, partially written input, restart and side-effect idempotency.

question: Caching
default: Add only against a measured repeated-cost problem.
alternative_trigger: Adopt a cache after defining versioned key, auth scope, invalidation, eviction and correctness tolerance.
acceptance: Stale data, wrong tenant, race, eviction and cold-start tests.

question: Configuration
default: One typed config contract with explicit source precedence.
alternative_trigger: Platform/product overrides must be named and testable, not ambient surprises.
acceptance: Missing/invalid value, conflicting precedence and clean environment tests.

question: Secrets and authorization
default: Existing approved secret/auth capability, least privilege and separate identity from authority.
alternative_trigger: New trust boundary or credential type requires an explicit integration contract.
acceptance: Denied scope, expired credential, redaction and no-secret-in-artifact tests.

question: Telemetry
default: Shared structured event/trace/context contract with useful failure and budget measurements.
alternative_trigger: Add backend-specific exporters through bounded adapters.
acceptance: Trace continuity, error attribution, sensitive-data exclusion and overhead budget.

question: Dependency ownership
default: External package or narrow shared adapter with explicit source/license/upgrade owner.
alternative_trigger: Focused fork when upstream cannot satisfy a required and evidenced constraint.
acceptance: Cold resolution, license/provenance, upstream delta and patch expiry.

question: Generated assets/config
default: One source and deterministic generator; derived views are not independent writers.
alternative_trigger: Handwritten extension seams are explicit and preserved.
acceptance: Regeneration determinism and changed-source drift fails check.

question: Check versus repair
default: Check reports the original state without changing tracked source.
alternative_trigger: Explicit repair may mutate authorized files; cache writes are declared.
acceptance: Known defect fails before repair; tracked-diff guard remains empty on check.

question: Test selection
default: Reviewed eligible source, boundary and journey inventories.
alternative_trigger: Exclude only with an owned applicability reason, not to make coverage green.
acceptance: Missing file, empty suite, bad glob and wrong revision controls.

question: Test independence
default: Verifier path and accepted evaluator identity cannot be silently rewritten by the builder.
alternative_trigger: Supplement semantic review without treating another model prompt as independence.
acceptance: Evaluator tamper, fabricated receipt and stale artifact controls.

question: Documentation
default: Shared production/federation pipeline; product-owned meaning and version lineage.
alternative_trigger: Framework-specific adapter only when needed by a real content/consumer requirement.
acceptance: Examples execute; links/versions/access boundaries fail when invalid.

question: Landing composition
default: Shared product descriptor, design/scene primitives and delivery plumbing.
alternative_trigger: Product-specific narrative/interaction stays a named authored extension.
acceptance: CTA destinations, interactive flows, responsive states and release linkage.

question: Design/interaction
default: One token/component authority with scoped extensions.
alternative_trigger: A distinct product experience can alter composition without forking commodity styles.
acceptance: Token propagation, keyboard behavior, visual/state and interaction evidence.

question: Accessibility
default: Required keyboard/focus/semantics/contrast/assistive behavior has a reviewed test inventory.
alternative_trigger: Domain-specific input/output modes add obligations rather than remove basics.
acceptance: Actual navigation and state changes; automated assertions plus anchored review.

question: Localization/content
default: Typed messages/content and explicit locale/version fallbacks.
alternative_trigger: Product terminology or locale requirements use owned extensions.
acceptance: Missing keys, expansion, directionality where relevant, and no accidental secrets.

question: Performance profiles
default: Choose a qualified workload/target profile, not one generic optimization level.
alternative_trigger: Separate latency, throughput, size, compile-time and energy objectives where necessary.
acceptance: Representative shape/load distribution, cold/warm runs and raw results.

question: Polyglot extraction
default: Isolate the measured hot path behind a narrow, batchable boundary.
alternative_trigger: Whole component rewrite only when simpler extraction cannot deliver the accepted requirement.
acceptance: Numerical/semantic parity plus full FFI/copy/startup/package cost.

question: Model/tool budget
default: Bound requests, context, output, retries and concurrency by useful completion and current quotas.
alternative_trigger: Change routing/model mix only with capability, latency, cost and failure evidence.
acceptance: Budget exhaustion, cache miss, provider failure, cancellation and fallback-policy tests.

question: Feature flags
default: Typed, owned and observable release controls with expiry or supported-profile status.
alternative_trigger: Permanent variation becomes an explicit tested profile.
acceptance: Enabled/disabled/version combinations and removal plan.

question: Packaging and install
default: Build a real artifact and exercise outside the checkout and developer shell.
alternative_trigger: Use role-appropriate library/CLI/service/app acceptance.
acceptance: Version/digest, cold install, first-run/core task/restart and missing source tree.

question: Release promotion
default: Promote the exact qualified artifact, preserving source/evaluator/environment linkage.
alternative_trigger: Rebuilds or retags require identity reconciliation and applicable re-verification.
acceptance: Artifact matches receipt; no source-only claim of installed success.

question: Rollback/data safety
default: Retain a traceable last-qualified state and test restoration appropriate to changed state.
alternative_trigger: Irreversible migration requires separately established authority and recovery strategy.
acceptance: Restore/replay and consumer compatibility tests.

question: Agent coordination
default: Capability-scoped work claims; one integration writer for shared manifests/releases.
alternative_trigger: Parallel unrelated investigations and isolated worktrees remain allowed.
acceptance: No dirty-state overwrite; base revision/lease checks and handoff receipt.

question: Tooling update cadence
default: Detect stale selected releases and qualify replacements in representative consumers.
alternative_trigger: Security/correctness incidents can trigger an expedited but evidenced path.
acceptance: Upstream change, compatibility delta, staged rollout and explicit blocked consumers.
